messages.subject: Error message: "Argument is of length zero"
parts:
Hello,

I'm new to home range estimates and have been working through some of the vignettes and other documentation online. Yesterday I was able to create some nice visuals while going through the AKDE vignette, but I had to restart my computer, and now I can't seem to reproduce the same result. I keep getting this error: "Error in if (fast) { : argument is of length zero" when I try to run akde().

Maybe it's a simple fix and I'm just missing something, but I can't seem to figure it out. I've attached a chunk of my code that should everything needed to get to where I'm at, plus the dataset. Any suggestions or guidance would be very much appreciated!!

Chris
